Может ли гражданин России купить квартир: Can foreigners buy an apartment in Serbia?
Да. Граждане России, как и многих других: Yes. Citizens of most countries can buy apartments and houses in Serbia. You need a passport and a Serbian tax identification number, which is issued during the transaction. Agricultural land is harder for foreigners to buy; we review such cases individually.
Стороны подписывают предварительный дого: The parties sign a preliminary contract and pay a deposit, then the main contract is certified by a notary. After payment, ownership is registered in the cadastre. We check the documents before the deposit and accompany the deal until registration.
Что проверить перед покупкой?: What should be checked before buying?
Главное — выписка из кадастра: кто собст: Above all, the cadastre extract: who the owner is and whether there are encumbrances such as a mortgage or a lien. It is also worth checking that the apartment is legalised (uknjižen), that the actual area matches the documents and that any alterations were approved.
Какие налоги и расходы при покупке?: What taxes and costs are involved in buying?
Обычно это налог на передачу права собст: Usually the property transfer tax, or VAT if the seller is a developer, plus notary fees and cadastre registration. The tax amount and who pays it depend on the type of transaction, so we calculate the exact figure for each property.
Даёт ли покупка недвижимости право на ВН: Does buying property give a right to a residence permit?
В Сербии есть основание для временного п: Serbia has a ground for temporary residence linked to property ownership. The requirements and the list of documents change from time to time, so we confirm the current conditions before the deal and help prepare the documents.
Как снять квартиру в Белграде иностранцу: How can a foreigner rent an apartment in Belgrade?
Так же, как гражданину Сербии: нужен пас: The same way as a Serbian citizen: you need a passport and a lease with the owner. You choose apartments in the catalogue or send a request; we arrange viewings with the owners, go with you, help agree the terms and check the lease before you sign.
Какой депозит просят собственники?: What deposit do owners ask for?
Обычно депозит равен одной месячной арен: Usually one month's rent, sometimes two. It is returned when you move out if the apartment is in good order. Owners often ask for the first month's rent and the deposit when the lease is signed.
Входят ли коммунальные платежи в цену ар: Are utilities included in the rent?
Как правило, нет: электричество, отоплен: Usually not: electricity, heating, water, waste collection and internet are paid separately on bills. In winter, with central heating, the total is noticeably higher than in summer. Before the viewing we ask the owner roughly how much it comes to per month.
На какой срок сдают квартиры?: How long are apartments rented for?
Большинство собственников сдают на срок: Most owners rent for a year or longer. A 6-month lease is possible, but not with every owner. We do not offer short-term daily rentals.
Что такое белый картон и кто его оформля: What is the white card and who arranges it?
Белый картон — это подтверждение регистр: The white card (beli karton) is proof that a foreigner's place of residence is registered with the police. You need it to open a bank account and apply for a residence permit. Registration is usually done by the owner, or by the tenant together with the owner. We agree on it in advance so there is no refusal later.

Бараево — сельская община к юго-западу о: Barajevo is a rural municipality south-west of Belgrade: villages, private houses, weekend cottages and plots.
Жильё здесь одно из самых доступных в Бе: Housing here is among the most affordable in the Belgrade area. It suits people who want their own house outside the city and are happy to drive into Belgrade.
Вождовац — большая община к югу от центр: Voždovac is a large municipality south of the centre. Closer to the centre it is dense urban housing with good transport; further out are the quiet residential areas of Banjica, Medaković and Kumodraž. Mount Avala with its TV tower is on the southern edge.
Здесь много семейных квартир разного раз: There are many family apartments of different sizes and standards, as well as new buildings. People choose it for the balance of price, proximity to the centre and green areas.
Врачар — самая маленькая и одна из самых: Vračar is the smallest and one of the most prestigious municipalities in Belgrade, just south of the historic centre. It is home to the Church of Saint Sava, Kalenić market and many cafés, and almost everything is within walking distance.
Застройка в основном довоенная и послево: Most buildings are pre-war and post-war: brick blocks of 4–6 storeys with high ceilings and few new buildings. It suits people who want to live in the centre without a car. Rents and prices are among the highest in the city, and parking can be difficult.
Гроцка — пригородная община на юго-восто: Grocka is a suburban municipality in the south-east along the Danube. It includes the old town of Grocka, the large Kaluđerica neighbourhood on the Belgrade border and villages with orchards and vineyards.
Это в основном частные дома и участки, ж: It is mostly private houses and plots, and housing is cheaper than in the city. You need a car or a bus to reach central Belgrade, so it suits people who value their own house and garden.
Звездара — холмистый жилой район к восто: Zvezdara is a hilly residential area east of the centre, home to Zvezdara Forest, the astronomical observatory and Đeram market. It is close to the centre but calmer, and prices are usually lower than in Vračar.
Застройка смешанная: многоэтажки, неболь: The housing is mixed: apartment blocks, small houses and new residential complexes. It is a good fit for people who want to live near the centre and close to green space.
Земун — бывший отдельный город на берегу: Zemun is a former separate town on the Danube, now part of Belgrade. Old Zemun, with the Gardoš Tower, fish restaurants on the riverfront and narrow streets, has kept a small-town atmosphere.
В общину входят и более новые районы, на: The municipality also includes newer areas such as Zemun Polje and Batajnica, with more private houses and lower prices. Zemun is convenient for New Belgrade and the airport, and the Danube promenade is one of the nicest places for a walk.
Лазаревац — отдельный город на юге Белгр: Lazarevac is a separate town in the south of the Belgrade area, about 60 km from the city centre. The large Kolubara coal basin is nearby, so many residents work in the energy sector.
Цены на жильё здесь значительно ниже бел: Housing here is much cheaper than in Belgrade. Lazarevac suits people who work in the town or nearby rather than commuting to Belgrade every day.
Младеновац — город примерно в 55 км к юг: Mladenovac is a town about 55 km south-east of Belgrade, with a railway station and the Selters Banja spa.
Это спокойный небольшой город с доступны: It is a quiet small town with affordable housing, private houses and apartments. It suits people who want to live outside the capital but still be able to travel there by train or car.
Новый Белград — район на левом берегу Са: New Belgrade lies on the left bank of the Sava and was built in the second half of the 20th century to a single plan: wide boulevards, numbered "blocks" of high-rise buildings, plenty of greenery, business centres and large shopping malls.
Район популярен у семей и у тех, кто раб: It is popular with families and with people who work in the offices of New Belgrade. Обреновац — небольшой город на реке Саве: Obrenovac is a small town on the Sava about 30 km south-west of central Belgrade and a separate municipality with its own schools, hospitals and shops.
Жильё в Обреновце заметно дешевле, чем в: Housing in Obrenovac is noticeably cheaper than in Belgrade. It suits people who work locally or are prepared to commute to the city every day.

Выбор жилья очень разный: от квартир в с: The choice of housing is very varied: from apartments in old buildings near the centre to new complexes and private houses. Prices are noticeably lower than in the centre, especially on the left bank of the Danube.
Раковица — спокойный жилой район на юго-: Rakovica is a quiet residential area in south-west Belgrade: Miljakovac, Kanarevo Brdo, Resnik. Košutnjak forest park and the Rakovica Monastery are nearby.
Цены на аренду и покупку здесь обычно ни: Rents and prices are usually lower than in the central municipalities. It suits people who are happy to travel a little longer to the centre for peace and quiet and more affordable housing.

Здесь удобно тем, кто ценит зелень и тиш: It is a good fit for people who value greenery and quiet close to the centre. Old buildings stand next to new residential complexes, so the choice is wide: from small apartments in pre-war buildings to spacious apartments with river views.

Дома в основном старые, часто без лифта,: Buildings are mostly old, often without an elevator, but full of character with high ceilings. Dorćol by the Danube is quieter and greener; the area near Kalemegdan is livelier. The centre can be noisy in the evenings, and parking is paid and scarce.

Район любят семьи за зелень, спорт и спо: Families love it for the greenery, sports and relaxed atmosphere. There are many apartment blocks and some new residential complexes. The centre is easy to reach by bus or tram.
